identification: Box of about 14 modern retro-style tin litho wind-up toys and a puzzle: tin carousel with swing seats, elephant on tricycle with ball, elephant-cyclist, Noddy-style car with figure, gnome car, boy pushing ice cream cart, jumping frog, penguin, duck, fire engine, monkey on motorbike, biplane; plus a pink plastic lace-pattern box of wooden jigsaw pieces (tea-pot/children's puzzle). The tin toys look like current Chinese-made nostalgic reproductions (Schylling-style), not 1950s originals; bright unfaded litho. No maker marks readable.
